questions.question:
Study the following line graph carefully and answer the question below.

Given graph represents marks obtained by Riya and Rida in six subjects of 12th exam of CBSE. Maximum marks in Maths, Physics and Chemistry is 140 whereas maximum marks in English. IP and Biology is 180.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/74a421dc37e0b41b5faf571bf7523388406c35a8f8d3d739cffee855af5662b5.png] 

What is percentage marks obtained by Rida in PCM (Maths, Physics and Chemistry)?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Maximum marks in Maths, Physics, and Chemistry = 140 each

Marks obtained by Rida in Maths = 70

Marks obtained by Rida in Physics = 110

Marks obtained by Rida in Chemistry = 120

**Formula Used:**

Percentage Marks = (Marks obtained/Maximum marks) × 100

**Calculation:**

Total marks obtained by Rida in PCM = 70 + 110 + 120 = 300

Total maximum marks in PCM = 140 × 3 = 420

Percentage Marks = (300/420) × 100

⇒ Percentage Marks = 71.43%

**The percentage of marks obtained by Rida in PCM is 71.43%.**

questions.question: In ΔABC,XY is drawn parallel to BC, cutting sides at X and Y, where AB = 5.4 cm ,BC = 7.2 cm and BX = 3 cm. What is the length of XY (in cm)?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

In ΔABC, XY is drawn parallel to BC, cutting sides at X and Y.

AB = 5.4 cm

BC = 7.2 cm

BX = 3 cm

**Formula Used:**

By Basic Proportionality Theorem (Thales' theorem):

If a line is drawn parallel to one side of a triangle, it divides the other two sides proportionally.

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3d9a87bc5d8c5094ae8ce6c1db735684ce5bcc029108175de00e45295b4af0d7.png] 

By Basic Proportionality Theorem,

AX / XB = AY / YC

Let AX = x and AY = y.

We know AB = AX + XB, so 5.4 = x + 3

⇒ x = 5.4 - 3

⇒ x = 2.4 cm

Now, AX / XB = AY / YC

⇒ 2.4 / 3 = y / (7.2 - y)

⇒ 2.4(7.2 - y) = 3y

⇒ 17.28 - 2.4y = 3y

⇒ 17.28 = 5.4y

⇒ y = 17.28 / 5.4

⇒ y = 3.2 cm

Therefore, the length of XY is 3.2 cm.

**The correct answer is option 4.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__** By Basic Proportionality Theorem,

AX / AB = XY / BC

AX = 5.4 - 3 = 2.4

2.4 / 5.4 = XY / 7.2

XY = (2.4 × 7.2) / 5.4 = 3.2 cm

The correct answer is option 4.

The graphs of two linear equations, x + 2y = 15 and 4x + 8y = 13 will be:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Compare the coefficients of the variables **x** and **y** in the given equations.

Ratio of x-coefficients (a₁/a₂) = 1/4

Ratio of y-coefficients (b₁/b₂) = 2/8 = 1/4

Ratio of constants (c₁/c₂) = 15/13

Since 1/4 = 1/4 ≠ 15/13, the lines are **parallel**.

**∴ The correct answer is parallel.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Equation 1: **x + 2y = 15** (where a₁ = 1, b₁ = 2, c₁ = 15)

Equation 2: **4x + 8y = 13** (where a₂ = 4, b₂ = 8, c₂ = 13)

**Condition for Parallel Lines:**

For two linear equations a₁x + b₁y = c₁ and a₂x + b₂y = c₂, the lines are **parallel** if:

(a₁/a₂) = (b₁/b₂) ≠ (c₁/c₂)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f05131ce6e8f55241315b02c2282112776cb6a09c28bba4f8d5268768c149f70.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ a₁/a₂ = 1/4

⇒ b₁/b₂ = 2/8 = 1/4

⇒ c₁/c₂ = 15/13

⇒ 1/4 = 1/4 ≠ 15/13

⇒ Therefore, the system of equations has **no solution** and the graphs are **parallel lines**.

**∴ The correct answer is parallel.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Intersecting Lines

If (a₁/a₂) ≠ (b₁/b₂), the lines intersect at exactly **one point** (Unique solution).

Coincident Lines

If (a₁/a₂) = (b₁/b₂) = (c₁/c₂), the lines overlap and are **coincident** (Infinitely many solutions).

Consistency

A system is **Inconsistent** if the lines are parallel (no solution) and **Consistent** if there is at least one solution.</p

questions.question: A boat can travel 60km downstream in 4 hours. If the speed of the boat in still water is 13 km/h, then in what time will it cover 30 km upstream?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Distance downstream = 60 km

Time taken downstream = 4 hours

Speed of the boat in still water = 13 km/h

Distance to cover upstream = 30 km

**Formula Used:**

Speed downstream = Distance downstream / Time downstream

Speed downstream = Speed of boat in still water + Speed of stream

Speed upstream = Speed of boat in still water - Speed of stream

Time upstream = Distance upstream / Speed upstream

**Calculation:**

Speed downstream = 60 km / 4 h

Speed downstream = 15 km/h

Speed downstream = Speed of boat in still water + Speed of stream

15 km/h = 13 km/h + Speed of stream

Speed of stream = 15 km/h - 13 km/h

Speed of stream = 2 km/h

Speed upstream = Speed of boat in still water - Speed of stream

Speed upstream = 13 km/h - 2 km/h

Speed upstream = 11 km/h

Time upstream = Distance upstream / Speed upstream

Time upstream = 30 km / 11 km/h

Time upstream = (30)/(11) hours

Time upstream = 2 (8)/(11) hours

**The correct answer is option 4.**

questions.question: During the first year the population of a village increased by 5% and during the second year it diminished by 5%. At the end of the second year its population was 47,880. What was the population at the beginning of the first year?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Net percentage change = 5 − 5 − (5 × 5) ÷ 100 = −0.25%

Net population ratio = 100% − 0.25% = 99.75%

99.75% of population = 47,880

Initial population = 47,880 ÷ 0.9975 = 48,000

**∴ The correct answer is 48000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Final population = 47,880, **First year increase** = 5%, **Second year decrease** = 5%.

**Formula Used:** Final Value = Initial Value × (1 + r₁/100) × (1 − r₂/100)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/97f0bd35458f5f5ac9ff15beca3bdd69790354aa60b19b078bb95b3a05b33600.png] 

⇒ Let the population at the beginning be P.

⇒ Population after 1st year = P × (1 + 5/100) = P × (105/100) = 21P/20

⇒ Population after 2nd year = (21P/20) × (1 − 5/100) = (21P/20) × (95/100) = (21P/20) × (19/20)

⇒ (21P/20) × (19/20) = 47,880

⇒ 399P / 400 = 47,880

⇒ P = (47,880 × 400) ÷ 399

⇒ P = 120 × 400 = 48,000

**∴ The correct answer is 48000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Percentage Change

When a value changes by x% and then y%, the net change is given by [x + y + (xy/100)]%.

Population Growth Formula

The final population after n years with constant growth rate r is Pₙ = P₀(1 ± r/100)ⁿ.

Ratio Method for Percentages

A 5% increase corresponds to a ratio of 21/20, while a 5% decrease corresponds to a ratio of 19/20.</p

questions.question: What is the value of cos(x + y) - sin(x - y) + tan(2z)?

options.text: sin x. sin y + (2 tan z)/(1-tan ² z)
cos x. cos y - sin x. sin y - sin x. cos y + cos x. sin y + (2 tan z)/(1-tan ² z)
cos x. cos y - sin x. sin y - cos x. sin y + (tan z)/(1-tan ² z)
cos x. cos y - sin x. sin y - sin x. cos y - cos x. sin y + (2 tan z)/(1-tan ² z)

questions.solution:
**Given:**

We need to find the value of cos(x + y) - sin(x - y) + tan(2z) .

**Formula Used:**

cos(x + y) = cos x · cos y - sin x · sin y

sin(x - y) = sin x · cos y - cos x · sin y

tan(2z) = (2 tan z)/(1 - tan² z)

**Calculation:**

Using the formulas:

cos(x + y) = cos x · cos y - sin x · sin y

sin(x - y) = sin x · cos y - cos x · sin y

tan(2z) = (2 tan z)/(1 - tan² z)

Combining these results:

⇒ cos(x + y) - sin(x - y) + tan(2z)

⇒ cos x · cos y - sin x · sin y - (sin x · cos y - cos x · sin y) + (2 tan z)/(1 - tan² z)

⇒ cos x · cos y - sin x · sin y - sin x · cos y + cos x · sin y + (2 tan z)/(1 - tan² z)

⇒ cos x · cos y - sin x · sin y - sin x · cos y + cos x · sin y + (2 tan z)/(1 - tan² z)

**The correct answer is option 2.**

questions.question: Twelve men working for 9 hours a day complete a piece of work in 24 days. In how many days can 8 men working for 12 hours a day complete the same piece of work?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

12 men working 9 hours/day complete the work in 24 days.

**Formula Used:**

Work = Number of Men × Number of Hours/Day × Number of Days

**Calculation:**

Work done by 12 men in 24 days:

Work = 12 × 9 × 24

Work = 2592 man-hours

Now, let x be the number of days required for 8 men working 12 hours/day to complete the same work.

Work = 8 × 12 × x

Since the work is the same, we set the equations equal:

8 × 12 × x = 2592

⇒ x = 2592 / (8 × 12)

⇒ x = 2592 / 96

⇒ x = 27

**The number of days required is 27 days.**

questions.question: How much water should be added to 60 liters of milk at 1 (1)/(2) liters a rupee so as to have a mixture worth 1 (7)/(8) liters a rupee?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Convert **quantity per rupee** to **price per liter**.

**CP of Milk** = 1 ÷ (3/2) = ₹2/3 per liter.

**CP of Water** = ₹0 per liter.

**Mean Price** = 1 ÷ (15/8) = ₹8/15 per liter.

Using **Alligation**: Ratio of Milk to Water = (8/15 − 0) : (2/3 − 8/15) = 8/15 : 2/15 = 4 : 1.

If 4 units = 60 liters, then 1 unit = 15 liters.

**∴ The correct answer is 15 liters.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Initial quantity of **milk** = 60 liters

Rate of milk = 1.5 liters per rupee ⇒ Price = ₹1/1.5 = ₹2/3 per liter

Rate of mixture = 1.875 liters per rupee ⇒ Price = ₹1/1.875 = ₹8/15 per liter

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/40a2ba112d5e170893558edbb8e67ff7c13624c606cea12d4807cb013d90cea0.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the quantity of **water** added be 'x' liters.

⇒ Total quantity of mixture = (60 + x) liters.

⇒ Cost of milk + Cost of water = Cost of mixture

⇒ 60 × (2/3) + x × 0 = (60 + x) × (8/15)

⇒ 40 = (60 + x) × 8/15

⇒ 40 × 15 = 480 + 8x

⇒ 600 = 480 + 8x

⇒ 8x = 120

⇒ x = 15 liters

**∴ The correct answer is 15 liters.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Alligation Rule

It states that (Quantity of cheaper / Quantity of dearer) = (Price of dearer − Mean Price) / (Mean Price − Price of cheaper).

Cost of Water

In problems involving **milk and water**, the cost price of water is always assumed to be **zero** unless specified otherwise.

Unit Consistency

Always ensure all values (CP of cheaper, CP of dearer, and Mean Price) are in the **same units** (e.g., ₹ per liter) before applying the alligation rule.

questions.question: If the diameter of a hemisphere is 21 cm , then the curved surface area (in cm²) of the hemisphere is: Take pi=(22)/(7)
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Diameter of the hemisphere = 21 cm

Radius (r) = Diameter / 2 = 21 / 2 = 10.5 cm

**Formula Used:**

Curved Surface Area (CSA) of a hemisphere = 2πr²

**Calculation:**

Radius (r) = 10.5 cm

π = 22 / 7

Curved Surface Area (CSA) = 2 × π × r²

CSA = 2 × (22 / 7) × (10.5)²

CSA = 2 × (22 / 7) × 110.25

CSA = 2 × 22 × 15.75

CSA = 693 cm²

**The correct answer is option 4: 693 cm².**

questions.question: Simplify: 18 ÷ (7 × 2 - 5) × 5 × 24 ÷ 30
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Simplify: 18 ÷ (7 × 2 - 5) × 5 × 24 ÷ 30

**Formula Used:**

Order of operations (PEMDAS/BODMAS): Parentheses, Exponents, Multiplication and Division (left to right), Addition and Subtraction (left to right)

**Calculation:**

18 ÷ (7 × 2 - 5) × 5 × 24 ÷ 30

First, solve inside the parentheses:

7 × 2 = 14

14 - 5 = 9

Now the expression is:

18 ÷ 9 × 5 × 24 ÷ 30

Next, perform the divisions and multiplications from left to right:

⇒ 18 ÷ 9 = 2

⇒ 2 × 5 = 10

⇒ 10 × 24 = 240

⇒ 240 ÷ 30 = 8

**The correct answer is option 1: 8**

questions.question: The capacity of a cylinder tank is 8316 cm³. If the radius of its base is 21 cm, then find the depth of the tank.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Capacity of the cylinder tank = 8316 cm³

Radius of the base (r) = 21 cm

**Formula Used:**

Volume of a cylinder = πr²h

Where, π (pi) ≈ 22/7, r = radius, h = height (or depth)

**Calculation:**

Volume = πr²h

8316 = (22/7) × 21² × h

⇒ 8316 = (22/7) × 441 × h

⇒ 8316 = 22 × 63 × h

⇒ 8316 = 1386h

⇒ h = 8316 / 1386

⇒ h = 6 cm

**The depth of the tank is 6 cm.**

questions.question: O is the centre and the arc PQR subtends an angle of 240° at O. PQ is extended to A. Then ∠AQR is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Angle subtended by **major arc PQR** at **centre O** = 240°

Angle subtended by the same arc at **circumference** (say ∠PSR) = 240° ÷ 2 = 120°

In a **cyclic quadrilateral**, the **exterior angle** is equal to the **interior opposite angle**.

Since **PQ** is extended to **A**, the exterior angle ∠AQR = interior opposite ∠PSR.

⇒ ∠AQR = 120°

**∴ The correct answer is 120°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Centre of circle = **O**

Angle subtended by **arc PQR** at O = 240°

**PQ** is extended to point **A**.

**Property used:**

1. The angle subtended by an arc at the centre is double the angle subtended by it at any point on the remaining part of the circle.

2. The sum of opposite angles of a **cyclic quadrilateral** is 180°.

3. **Exterior angle** of a cyclic quadrilateral is equal to the **interior opposite angle**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/584ae4ab1df3f4f219fdd404ab564b1b32706eb6540158b44221c14c0dd59811.png] 

Let **S** be any point on the minor arc **PR**.

⇒ Reflex ∠POR = 240° (Angle subtended by arc PQR at centre)

⇒ ∠PSR = 1/2 × Reflex ∠POR

⇒ ∠PSR = 1/2 × 240° = 120°

Now, **PQRS** is a **cyclic quadrilateral** because all four vertices lie on the circle.

⇒ ∠PQR + ∠PSR = 180° (Opposite angles of cyclic quadrilateral)

⇒ ∠PQR = 180° − 120° = 60°

Since **PQA** is a straight line (extension of PQ):

⇒ ∠PQR + ∠AQR = 180° (Linear pair)

⇒ ∠AQR = 180° − 60° = 120°

**∴ The correct answer is 120°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Angle at Centre Theorem

The angle subtended by an arc at the center is exactly double the angle subtended by the same arc at any point on the circumference of the circle.

Cyclic Quadrilateral Exterior Angle

The exterior angle formed by extending one side of a cyclic quadrilateral is always equal to the interior opposite angle of the quadrilateral.

Opposite Angles Property

In any cyclic quadrilateral, the sum of a pair of opposite angles is always 180° (supplementary angles).</p

questions.question: In a group of 250 persons, 40% are males and 60% are females. If 30 more females join the group, then what will be the percentage of females in the new group? (Correct to 2 decimal places)
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Total persons in the group = 250

Percentage of males = 40%

Percentage of females = 60%

Additional females joining the group = 30

**Formula Used:**

Percentage of females in the new group = (Number of females in the new group / Total number of persons in the new group) × 100

**Calculation:**

Number of females in the original group = 60% of 250

Number of females in the original group = 0.60 × 250

Number of females in the original group = 150

Number of females in the new group = 150 + 30

Number of females in the new group = 180

Total number of persons in the new group = 250 + 30

Total number of persons in the new group = 280

Percentage of females in the new group = (180 / 280) × 100

Percentage of females in the new group = (180 / 280) × 100

Percentage of females in the new group = 0.642857 × 100

Percentage of females in the new group = 64.29%

**The percentage of females in the new group is 64.29%.**

questions.question: A dozen pairs of gloves of Rs. 180 are available at a discount of 10%. How many pairs of gloves can be bought for Rs. 54?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Discounted Price** of 12 pairs = 180 − (10% of 180) = 180 − 18 = 162.

**Price per pair** = 162 ÷ 12 = 13.5.

**Number of pairs** for Rs. 54 = 54 ÷ 13.5 = 4.

**∴ The correct answer is 4 pairs.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given → **Marked Price (MP)** of 12 pairs = Rs. 180, **Discount** = 10%, **Total Amount** = Rs. 54.
Formulas: SP = MP × (100 − Discount%) ÷ 100 | Quantity = Total Amount ÷ SP per unit.
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/be5936b74cc1ac55468d55716b728a7ea1e2aaecb6e578a769da96059e7e8fdb.png] 
⇒ **Selling Price (SP)** for 12 pairs = 180 × (90 ÷ 100) = Rs. 162.
⇒ Cost of **1 pair** of gloves = 162 ÷ 12 = Rs. 13.5.
⇒ Pairs bought for Rs. 54 = 54 ÷ 13.5.
⇒ Pairs = 4.

**∴ The correct answer is 4 pairs.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Marked Price & Discount

The **Marked Price** is the price printed on the label. **Discount** is always calculated on the MP to find the **Selling Price**.

Unitary Method

Finding the value of a single unit first (price per pair) helps in calculating the quantity for any given total amount.
